snippet.description:
📡 FREE DEMO is out now! 📡 Play it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4185580/Signal_Zone/

Signal Zone is a minimalist strategic base-building and tower-defense survival game. Explore by day, gather resources, strengthen your defenses and survive enemy waves by night.
